data.text: [00:04.9]So, let’s find four things we’ve got in common … erm … what about going shopping? Do you like going shopping?
[00:12.8]Ermm … well, I’m not very keen on shopping in general, but … I like clothes shopping.
[00:19.8]Yes, me too. I really like looking for interesting clothes … you know, something a bit unusual … .
[00:26.9]Mmmm … I like looking for interesting, cheap clothes. `[00:30.9]Lots of clothes are so expensive, but if you look hard enough, you can usually find some bargains.

[00:37.7]Yes, it’s always good to find bargains! `[00:40.8]OK … well, I think that’s two things we’ve got in common: we both like shopping … clothes shopping, I mean. `[00:48.9]And both of us like looking for bargains.
[00:51.9]How do you usually pay for things when you go shopping? I pay in cash. `[00:57]Actually, I always pay in cash because I haven’t got a credit card or anything.
[01:03]Yes, that’s the same for me. I haven’t got a credit card either.
[01:07.5]OK … so, neither of us has got a credit card – that’s number three … ermm …
[01:15.3]And … number four is … we both pay in cash when we go shopping. Yeah … that’s four things we’ve got in common.
